name: interactive-restaurantes
description: Sistema completo de restaurantes interativos com módulos de anúncios e IA

scripts.start: concurrently "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:admin" "npm run start:ads" "npm run start:client-web" "npm run start:client-app"
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:admin" "npm run dev:ads" "npm run dev:client-web" "npm run dev:client-app"
scripts.build: cd admin-panel && npm run build && cd client-web && npm run build && cd ../client-app/ClientApp && npm run build
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:admin && npm run test:ads
